senses.gloss:
अव अव, a prefix. Away, off, down.
 I. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives.
 II. Former part of compounded nouns.
 --Cf. αὐ- in αὐερύω, αὖ, αὖτε; Lat. autem, aut.
 --This prefix is based on a pronoun अव, which is preserved in the Zend language, and in the former part of the compounded pronoun αὐ-τός.

अवकर्त अवकर्त, i. e. अव-कृत् + अ, m. A chip, Nal. 10, 22.
अवकर्तन अवकर्तन, i. e. अव-कृत् + अन, n. Cutting off, Nal. 10, 16.

 --Preceded by a numeral it implies ‘at least,’ e. g. त्रि-, three at least, Man. 8, 60; at least three times, Man. 11, 80; also, after कार्षापण-, a kārṣāpaṇa at least, Man. 8, 274.
अवर-अवर अवर-अवर, adj. lowest, Rām. 5, 53, 24.

 1. Supporting one's self, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 24.

अवलम्बिन् अव-लम्ब् + इन्, adj., f. नी.

 acc. सावष्टम्भम्, adv. courageously, Kathās. 25, 97.
